skill_name: Generate a persuasive argument to encourage young people to use public transportation more often
workflow: Using public transportation is an effective way to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Taking public transportation to work, shopping, and school can reduce single-occupancy vehicular accidents, as well as traffic congestion, which can help save money on fuel costs and get people to their destinations faster.
